crossRefs.note: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden…
I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of…
I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been…
All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.
Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced…
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…

translations.web: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
translations.bsb: So I set my mind to know wisdom and madness and folly; I learned that this, too, is a pursuit of the wind.
translations.kjv: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
translations.asv: And I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also was a striving after wind.
